title: An all-transistor physical-learning transformer can be trained to perform in-context learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.12571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. translated_title: 一种全晶体管物理学习Transformer可以被训练执行上下文学习
translated_abstract: 大多数通过平衡传播或耦合学习训练的系统都属于与多层感知器相同的类别：虽然它们可能是通用函数逼近器，但它们难以学习那些对Transformer而言很容易的关联任务。平衡传播依赖于信息在物理系统中输入与输出之间的双向流动。而更复杂的非线性系统会破坏这种反向流动，例如执行乘法运算的系统，而乘法正是表达点积注意力所必需的。在这里，我们通过在双电路（dyadic circuit）中引入额外的电路元件，显式地恢复了这种双向流动。随后，我们利用这些想法构建了一种注意力机制，该机制利用了亚阈值MOSFET器件的指数电流定律。我们通过仿真表明，尽管使用了现实的后向传输组件（摘要在此处截断），该电路仍可以被训练来执行一个简单的上下文学习任务。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种全晶体管物理学习Transformer，通过在双电路中引入额外电路元件恢复双向信息流，并利用亚阈值MOSFET的指数电流特性构建注意力机制，使物理系统首次能够被训练执行上下文学习任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an all-transistor physical-learning transformer that restores bidirectional information flow through dyadic circuits and builds an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFETs, enabling a physical system to be trained to perform in-context learning.
